_comment: All progression / shop / economy tunables. Money is in whole dollars. Score targets are for a nine-hole round and scale with round.holes_per_round.

side_bets._comment: Each round rolls `count` bets from the pool. Bets pay only on a completed, non-sandbox round. target_per_9 / rel_par_per_9 and rewards (unless reward_scales is false) are written for nine holes and scale with the round length.

pool.text: Par or better on every par 3
Par or better {n} holes in a row
Hit {n} shot{s} with clubs you bought

haggle._comment: One offer per listing at these stores. Accept odds = offer.accept * seller multiplier (Marketplace) or the shop owner's mood for this restock (Pawn), clamped to [0.02, 0.95]. A refused lowball can make the seller pull the listing. The roll is seeded per listing, so reloading can't retry it.

resale._comment: Offer = fair used value * lerp(rate_min, rate_max, condition). Fair value is model + condition only, never the paid price.

modifiers._comment: Hard bounds on how far any club can bend the working shot mechanics.

sellers.name: Flipper

sellers.name: Clueless Uncle

illegal._comment: Admin/sandbox only. Never in loot, shops, resale or collections.

manager._comment: Golf course manager. Locked until the player has unlocked `unlock.store` AND pays `unlock.deed_price` for the deed, so you earn your way up as a golfer first. Money per business hour; one business hour lasts `real_seconds_per_hour` real seconds and runs in the background while the game is open (a share of it, capped, while it's closed). Facilities are placed and paid for in Course Manager; each `levels` entry is what that level costs to reach and what it does (its model is assets/facilities/<id>_l<level>.gltf). Rooms live inside the clubhouse: each opens at clubhouse level `min_level` and has three `tiers`. A facility or room that names `staff` earns nothing until at least one of that role is hired; `crew` roles (one or a list) are optional and each head adds the role's `bonus_each`. Staff `works` says where they show up (course, a facility id, or room:<id>). A facility with `default_level` comes with the deed at that level (the parking lot); its `spaces` cap golfers at `golfers_per_space_hour` each (`street_spaces` when no lot is placed).

facilities.name: Clubhouse
facilities.blurb: Check-in, the pro shop and the locker rooms. Your course can't open without one, and each level opens new rooms.

facilities.name: Cart barn
facilities.blurb: Rental carts. A share of your golfers ride instead of walking.

facilities.name: Driving range
facilities.blurb: Hitting bays and target greens. Sells buckets to its own crowd as well as your golfers.

facilities.name: Short game area
facilities.blurb: Practice greens with real flags: putting first, then a chipping green, bunkers and hitting mats. Your golfers warm up on it before they tee off, and locals pay to sharpen their short game.

facilities.name: Parking lot
facilities.blurb: Where your golfers leave their cars. The deed comes with a gravel lot; when it's full the course can't take more golfers, so grow it with the course.

rooms.name: Pro shop
rooms.blurb: Balls, gloves, polos and bags. Every golfer through the door spends a little.

rooms.name: Locker rooms
rooms.blurb: Somewhere to change and freshen up. Better rooms lift the club and what it can charge.

rooms.name: Lobby
rooms.blurb: The first thing every golfer sees. A warm welcome brings them back.

rooms.name: Restaurant
rooms.blurb: The 19th hole. Golfers eat after their round, and a good kitchen brings people back.

rooms.name: Office
rooms.blurb: Bookings and the tee sheet. A better office fits more tee times into the day.

rooms.name: Ballroom
rooms.blurb: Weddings, galas and outings: bookings every hour whatever the golfers do.

rooms.name: Trophy lounge
rooms.blurb: The club's history on the walls. Prestige golfers will pay for.

rooms.name: Spa & fitness
rooms.blurb: Memberships that pay every hour, golf or not.

rooms.name: Simulator
rooms.blurb: Lessons and simulator bays rent by the hour, rain or shine.

rooms.name: Valet
rooms.blurb: Staffed parking and retrieval from the valet podium. Upgrade with a Capri umbrella, then a bag rack. Guests wait when no valet is at the podium; cart attendants handle golf carts.

staff.name: Greenskeeper
staff.blurb: Each keeps about 4 holes in shape. Course condition drives demand and the fair green fee.

staff.name: Marshal
staff.blurb: Keeps play moving: each adds 10% more tee times.

staff.name: Shop clerk
staff.blurb: Runs the pro shop. Each extra clerk sells 15% more.

staff.name: Receptionist
staff.blurb: Greets golfers at the lobby desk. Each adds 20% to what the lobby does for the club.

staff.name: Locker attendant
staff.blurb: Fresh towels and tidy lockers. Each adds 20% to what the locker rooms do for the club.

staff.name: Chef
staff.blurb: Runs the restaurant kitchen. Each extra chef serves 15% more.

staff.name: Server
staff.blurb: Works the dining room and the trophy lounge. Each serves 10% more.

staff.name: Bartender
staff.blurb: Runs the bar. Each pours 12% more.

staff.name: Cart attendant
staff.blurb: Charges, washes and brings the carts round. Each rents out 10% more.

staff.name: Range attendant
staff.blurb: Keeps the range open and the ball machine full. Each extra one adds 15%.

staff.name: Events coordinator
staff.blurb: Books and runs the ballroom. Each extra one fills it 20% more.

staff.name: Trainer
staff.blurb: Runs the gym and spa. Each extra trainer takes on 15% more members.

staff.name: Golf pro
staff.blurb: Teaches lessons in the simulator studio. Each extra pro books 20% more.

staff.name: Valet
staff.blurb: Parks and retrieves personal cars, unloading bags into the designated rack for cart attendants. Up to two valets; each adds 15% to valet service.

completion_reward.name: Gold Trophy Cabinet
completion_reward.description: All seven collectible putters owned at once. The cabinet turns gold and a plaque is engraved with your best round.
